payout_quote: As a new member, you'll receive $200 when you: Open a Free Checking account and a Membership Savings account. Establish and receive a single direct deposit of at least $1,000. Enroll in eStatements. To qualify, be sure to fulfill these requirements within 60 days of opening your account.
steps: Open a new Membership Savings account ($25 minimum balance) and a Free Checking account online via the promotional page, by phone, or in a branch - mention the promotion when opening in branch or over the phone
Within 60 calendar days of account opening: establish and receive a single direct deposit of at least $1,000 into the checking account and enroll in eStatements
Keep accounts open; the $200 bonus is deposited into the qualifying checking account no later than 10 business days of the month following the end of the 60-day period
catches: Requires a single $1,000+ direct deposit within 60 days - the highest DD threshold of the routes found so far in this lane
Offer available only to new members 18+; existing account owners and primary owners of a membership closed within the past 12 months are ineligible
Membership Savings requires a $25 minimum balance to open
Accounts must be open and not delinquent by more than 30 days at the time of bonus payment
Cannot be combined with any other Desert Financial account opening offer; employees and their immediate family members are ineligible
Bonus is reported as taxable income (IRS Form 1099-INT)
biggest_catch: You need a single direct deposit of at least $1,000 (not several smaller ones) within 60 days of opening, and if you had a Desert Financial membership closed in the past 12 months you are ineligible.
eligibility: New Desert Financial Credit Union members, 18 or older with valid SSN/TIN; no existing accounts and no membership closed within the past 12 months; employees and immediate family excluded.
timing: All requirements within 60 calendar days of account opening; bonus paid no later than 10 business days of the month following the end of the 60-day period.
weasel_words: Offer cannot be combined with any other account opening offer and is subject to change
